name: sentinelos-demo
description: Shareable demo video of SentinelOS — composed in Remotion from REAL frames captured off the running OS in QEMU. The video only adds title cards, pacing, and captions; it does NOT re-create the UI.

scripts.sync-frames: mkdir -p public/frames && rm -f public/frames/*.png && cp frames/frame_*.png public/frames/ && ls public/frames | wc -l
scripts.preview: npm run sync-frames && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run render:mp4 && npm run render:gif
scripts.render:mp4: npm run sync-frames && remotion render src/index.ts SentinelDemo out/sentinelos-demo.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:gif: npm run sync-frames && remotion render src/index.ts SentinelDemo out/sentinelos-demo.gif --codec=gif --every-nth-frame=3 --width=480
scripts.still: npm run sync-frames && remotion still src/index.ts SentinelDemo out/poster.png --frame=90
